customers_say: Customers find the water purifier to be the best in the market with a premium appearance and excellent installation process. The product receives positive feedback for its taste, with one customer noting it's free of metallic or chemical aftertaste, and its features are well-explained. The build quality and reliability receive mixed reviews - while some find it solid, others report it may break soon, and some units stopped working after a few days. Value for money is also mixed, with some customers finding it worth the price while others deeply regret their purchase.

The purifier adjusts according to the incoming water, which is quite convenient. Good product overall. Build quality is genuinely good. It feels sturdy and the finishing is also nice. reviews.author: Pradeep Kandaswamy
reviews.title: Atomberg Intellon - Great versatile purifier with smart TDS-based RO — recommended
reviews.body: Installed the Atomberg Intellon RO today (August 10, 2026), and overall, Very happy with the Atomberg Intellon so far. The TDS-based switching is a smart feature that reduces RO usage when it isn’t needed. This should help reduce wastewater while retaining more minerals, especially with the alkaliser. The water tastes clean and slightly alkaline, and the 8L tank is sufficient for our family of four. The technician installed a Pressure Reducing Value (PRV) free-of-cost as the input pressure was slightly high. The app monitoring and alerts work well, although the initial setup took a few minutes
